### CDEK courier tariff calculation with city code resolution

```mermaid
---
title: "CDEK courier tariff calculation with city code resolution"
---
graph LR
  BackendStoreApi@{ shape: rectangle, label: "Store API" }
  BackendFulfillmentCdek@{ shape: rectangle, label: "fulfillment-cdek" }
  Cdek@{ shape: rectangle, label: "CDEK" }
  BackendStoreApi -. "`requests shipping options for cart 
address`" .-> BackendFulfillmentCdek
  BackendFulfillmentCdek -. "`looks up city code for address (cached)`" .-> Cdek
  Cdek -. "`city code or not-found`" .-> BackendFulfillmentCdek
  BackendFulfillmentCdek -. "`calculates tariff with resolved city 
code`" .-> Cdek
  Cdek -. "`tariff or calculator error`" .-> BackendFulfillmentCdek
  BackendFulfillmentCdek -. "`price, or delivery-method error`" .-> BackendStoreApi
```
